name: wavy-stroke-bands
title: Wavy Stroke Bands
description: Nine wavy lines, each drawn three times as a thick soft halo, a medium band and a core line, draw on and off in a staggered wave while their width swells and the colour shifts from one tone to another.
useWhen: A calm, flowing line background is needed behind a title or a product shot.
A section break should feel like a ribbon of light sweeping across.
avoidWhen: The frame must stay still or very quiet.
The lines should follow a real chart: use animated-line-chart.
author: creativeocean

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Optional centered text over the lines. Leave empty for lines only.

variables.label: Line width
variables.description: Width of the core line in the 1200-unit drawing.
